name: flint-chart-plugin
description: Pick the right chart for the data and question, render it locally via the microsoft/flint-chart MCP server, then verify the rendered artifact actually says what it was meant to say. Combines a framing skill (intent check + Big Idea + story arc + audience + TRADITIONAL vs INNOVATIVE style stance), a chart-selection + rendering skill (Comparison / Trend / Distribution / Relationship / Proportion / Flow / KPI), a verification skill (console errors + failure catalogs + claim check), and a /render-chart prompt. Renders Vega-Lite / ECharts / Chart.js locally — no data leaves the machine.
